241	Achra, they would be pure, not impure, they would not be predators,

243	As it will be in the future to come: "The lion, like the ox, shall eat straw," and "the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard lie down with the kid."

244	That is, the Sitra Achra is here in the role of creating the screen of concealment.

245	But the vitality is not hers; the vitality belongs to holiness.

246	And what is the second thing that the Sitra Achra impresses upon us?

247	The illusion that she creates for us.

248	She creates for us an illusion that her size and her power are what rules, what

249	runs things, and what determines.

250	All this enormous power of the Sitra Achra that impresses us so much is, as we said before, not

251	the first part, that everything she has is not hers.

252	Rather, it is that everything she has has no reality at all.

253	There is no such thing; it is all illusion.

254	So if there is such an illusion, where does this illusion come from?

255	The Alter Rebe will explain that this illusion is a deliberate illusion that comes from the Holy One, blessed be He.

256	The Holy One, blessed be He, wants this illusion.

257	This is the purpose of the Sitra Achra: to produce for us this false show.

258	Let us see this inside the text.

259	He says: "For all her vitality, as

260	we said, is not from herself, heaven forbid."

261	Her vitality, which is what she has, is not hers, but evidently from the side of holiness.

262	And therefore, from the side of truth, she is entirely nullified

263	before holiness.

264	Whenever she stands against holiness, one immediately sees the truth that all she has is not hers.

265	And as we said before, a little light pushes away much darkness.

266	And she is nullified to holiness like the nullification of darkness before the light of a candle.

267	If so, the opposite question arises, what we said before, that if

268	so, how does she deceive us and create for us a false show

269	of something so powerful, that is as if the ruler and master of the whole

270	of reality?

271	So here is the deliberate concealment that HaShem created, and what is it?

272	Namely:

273	That with regard to the holiness of the divine soul

274	within a person,

275	the Holy One, blessed be He, who created man and gave him a holy soul, a divine soul,

276	and an animal soul, wanted

277	that the animal soul, whose source is in the klipah, would have the power to conceal the light of the holiness of

278	the divine soul.

279	And there is a purpose in this concealment.

280	That is, the Holy One, blessed be He, is the one who wanted to give the power to the Sitra Achra to create a reality of falsehood, which is not

281	true.

282	So why do we say she "nurses" from holiness?

283	Again, what she nurses from holiness is what HaShem gave her to pass

284	through her.

285	That is, the vitality of the physical things or of the souls we mentioned earlier, which pass through her,

286	and they pass through her so that she is the one who will conceal the source.

287	"Nursing," because nursing is something where you do not receive the thing in an open and full way; you receive it drop

288	by drop.

289	Then he says that the Holy One, blessed be He, in addition gave her permission, only with regard to, let us

290	see inside the text, only with regard to the holiness of the divine soul within a person, the Holy One,

291	blessed be He, gave her permission and ability to raise herself against it.

292	What does it mean to raise herself?

293	As if to rise above the divine soul, above holiness, and as it were to defy it.

294	What purpose can the Holy One, blessed be He, have in this?

295	The Holy One, blessed be He, is entirely truth: "HaShem your Elokim is true."

296	Where does this idea come from, that the Holy One, blessed be He, would give the Sitra Achra power to deceive the whole world, all

297	of reality?

298	And we understand that the Holy One, blessed be He, is the one who gave her the power. Why?

299	So let us look at an example that appears in the Torah.

300	The Torah tells us about Pharaoh.

301	Pharaoh was a king of enormous power, and at that time he ruled over the whole world.

302	So with all of Pharaoh's enormous power and his rule, to such a degree

303	that a slave could not escape from there.

304	Think of such a huge country, millions of people, perhaps tens or hundreds of millions;

305	a slave could not flee, because of the great power Pharaoh had.

306	Then the Holy One, blessed be He, begins to give him the plagues on the way to the Exodus from Egypt, and what does the Holy One,

307	blessed be He, say?

308	That He will harden Pharaoh's heart. That is, even though Pharaoh would receive the plagues and understand that there is

309	an Elokim (at first he said "I do not know HaShem"), he would understand the truth, to the point that at one stage he says,

310	"HaShem is righteous, and I and my people are the wicked." And did that help?

311	It did not help; again HaShem hardened his heart. That is, the Holy One, blessed be He, gave him a truly

312	deliberate power that made him deceive himself, not only everyone else.

313	And what purpose was there in this?

314	The purpose was very clear.

315	The Holy One, blessed be He, says, "I harden his heart, in order that I may multiply My wonders in the land of Egypt."

316	The Holy One, blessed be He, says: since I have a true purpose,

317	to do all ten plagues and all the miracles and wonders, brother, there was such a long period

318	of years in which the Egyptians afflicted the Jewish people so harshly and cruelly, I do not want the Jewish people to leave

319	suddenly, all at once, as if nothing had happened.

320	I want, as the saying goes, to strike the klipah to the end, until the

321	klipah is broken.

322	Therefore HaShem strengthens the klipah.

323	He strengthens it in order to bring it down.

324	What does it mean that He hardens Pharaoh's heart?

325	That although Pharaoh sees the truth,

326	he is unable; his denial is stronger than his logic.

327	Yes, it is like a Reform rabbi once,

328	who was in a private audience with the Rebbe, and told the Rebbe that it is impossible to convince people to believe, because

329	there are questions about faith.

330	The Rebbe told him that this is nonsense; after all, there are so many people in the world who believe, see how many millions believe

331	in Gandhi, in the Pope.

332	But he did not give up, he said to the Rebbe, "No, but the doubts are stronger

333	than the faith; they confuse the faith."

334	So the Rebbe tells him that these doubts that confuse the faith are not because the person truly

335	seeks to find the truth and does not manage to find it.

336	It is because he seeks to justify his desires.

337	And since he has...

338	He has, exactly. So you might come and say, if he is seeking his desires, then why does it work

339	for him?

340	Why do these doubts in the end really confuse him?

341	Because this is the power that HaShem gave

342	to the klipah, to create this falsehood.

343	It was a little over forty years ago, on Simchat Torah,

344	the Rebbe is dancing with the Chassidim, there are thousands upon thousands of Chassidim, and...

345	Since on Simchat Torah, the second day in the Diaspora, a day that in the Land of Israel is no longer a festival, a

346	delegation arrived from the Israeli embassy in New York, and came to the Rebbe.

347	And the ambassador was Benjamin Netanyahu, the Prime Minister.

348	Well, he was not the Prime Minister then; he was Israel's ambassador to the UN.

349	Then he sees the Rebbe, and says to the Rebbe,

350	"I came to see you."

351	And the Rebbe told him, "Only to see, not to speak?"

352	And in a very, very exceptional way, as never before,

353	in the middle of the hakafot the Rebbe stopped the entire event for forty minutes, and the Rebbe spoke with him

354	like that, inside the synagogue, in private.

355	Among the things the Rebbe said to him, he himself told this, later at the UN he told it, the Rebbe says

356	to him that in the place where you are there is a hall that is entirely full of falsehood.

357	A little light.

358	And your role is to light a small candle of truth that will drive out all this

359	falsehood.
